name: Late Night Show
description: Broadcasting from Hawaii, comedian and car journalist Casey Rollins hosts the new trending TV show: the Motorfest Late Show. Replacing its official driver Lucky Star, become the star of the program through a series of episodes and segments. Each episode will cover a specific theme with a special guest from the Motorfest. Are you ready to go on air?

events.name: ALPINE STAYS FROSTY
events.description: Alpine makes its grand entrance to the Motorfest Late Show! The occasion to showcase and discuss two iconic vehicles from the French brand's lineup with Casey's special guest.
events.car: ALPINE A110 R ULTIME, ALPINE ALPENGLOW Hy6 Concept

events.name: BEWARE OF THE WOLF
events.description: It's up to Dubai-based W Motors' second Hypercar, the Fenyr SuperSport, to be put to the test. Time for some choreographed shots in front of the Motorfest Late Show's cameras.

events.name: THE JAPANESE FALCON
events.description: Strap on your wearable camera and learn about the fascinating history of the legendary, ultrafast Japanese motorcycle, the Suzuki Hayabusa, in the company of Casey and the Archivist.

events.name: DELAGE'S RENAISSANCE
events.description: The Fenomeno represents a new design manifesto for Lamborghini. It celebrates the brand's DNA, renowned reputation for performance, and the 20th anniversary of its design department: the Centro Stile.

events.name: THE NEW PHENOMENON
events.description: The Fenomeno represents a new design manifesto for Lamborghini. It celebrates the brand's DNA, renowned reputation for performance, and the 20th anniversary of its design department: the Centro Stile.
Are you up for some steering madness? Pace the obstacle lap race conceived by Casey's teams using your beloved Fiat 500. Thrills guaranteed!

events.name: SPACCA TUTTO
events.description: Ever dreamed of stealing your dad's car to break stuff on camera? That's exactly what Casey's teams have planned for this segment. Get ready for the ultimate wreck!

events.name: ITALIAN COACHWORK
events.description: Coachwork in Italy is nothing less than the stuff of legend. Follow Casey's explanations on this exceptional art and its craftsmanship while driving a small array of splendid vehicles.
